name: manley-vari-mu-bus-glue
description: Gentle UADx Manley Variable Mu leveling/glue on a mix / 2-bus: a single dB or two of clean vari-mu cohesion. DUAL INPUT 6, threshold 6 (~1 dB GR), ATTACK 2 (slow = transparent, lets transients through), RECOVERY 'Med Slo' (open, no pump), COMP, HP SIDECHAIN 'In'. The clean tube alternative to VCA bus glue (ssl-bus-compressor-2) and the cleaner sibling of fc660-bus-glue. VALIDATED on the Watercolors warm drum bus: ~1 dB of cohesion — crest 17.17->17.29 (held), LRA 2.44->2.18 (tighter), true-peak -0.98, -0.11 LU. Transparent.
intended_for: a near-final mix / 2-bus that wants subtle tube cohesion before mastering (NOT a limiter; hand the result to master-track)
plugin_build: uaudio_manley_variable_mu.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the /Components/UAD Manley Variable Mu.component twin passes through offline, do not use it).
notes: Target ~1-2 dB GR for glue — read it as a gentle RMS pull with crest roughly held. More than ~3 dB on a full mix starts to pump unless you slow the recovery.
Slow ATTACK (2) + Med-Slo RECOVERY = the most transparent setting (highest crest in the sweep). Speed the recovery toward Fast for more obvious 'breathing' density.
For a true STEREO mix you can switch to in/out_matrix M-S + unlink to glue the centre without squashing the sides — see manley-vari-mu-master-ms-glue.
Harness-only (enum params). Hand off to master-track for loudness/limiting.
